purpose: Define secret value rotation while preserving logical secret identity and explicit old/new activation windows.

topics.name: Secret Rotation
topics.purpose: Define secret value rotation while preserving logical secret identity and explicit old/new activation windows.

semantics.identity_rule: Logical secret identity remains stable across value rotations.
semantics.activation_rule: New material activation time/state is explicit.
semantics.overlap_rule: Optional old/new overlap period is explicit and bounded.
semantics.consumer_rule: Consumers resolve current allowed version through the secret reference/provider profile.
semantics.audit_rule: Rotation evidence records identities/versions, never raw values.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: rotation creates new unrelated logical secret accidentally
raw secret value appears in audit
